## codex重置预测看板 2.0.1

加速模式换成黑底珊瑚橙：黑灰面板、珊瑚橙消耗横条，红色游泳线随预告时间推进。常规模式保留黑绿配色。

七语言宣传页和六张功能图同步更新。

下载 Windows x64 安装版或便携版。个人额度的设置步骤见[中文说明](https://github.com/zzy2670/codex-reset-forecast-dashboard/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)。

[查看图文介绍](https://zzy2670.github.io/codex-reset-forecast-dashboard/) · GPL-3.0-only

## English

Accelerated mode now uses coral orange on black: charcoal panels, coral usage bars and a red pacing line that advances toward the announced reset. Routine mode keeps its green palette.

The feature tour in seven languages and all six illustrations have been updated.

Download the Windows x64 installer or portable app. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/zzy2670/codex-reset-forecast-dashboard/blob/main/README.md) to set up personal quota.
